summary: Available now, this well-presented six-bedroom House in Multiple Occupation offers comfortable, modern accommodation in one of Darlington's most sought-after residential areas. Ideally suited to working professionals, the property provides spacious living with excellent access to local amenities, transport links, and major employers. The property comprises six generously sized bedrooms, a modern and fully equipped shared kitchen, comfortable communal living space, and multiple bathrooms to ensure convenience for all residents. The house benefits from gas central heating, double glazing throughout, and high-speed broadband availability. The property is well maintained and offers a welcoming, professional house-share environment.
